title: Database Administrator
description:
**Project Role :** Database Administrator  

**Project Role Description :** Design, implement and maintain databases. Install database management systems (DMBS). Develop procedures for day\-to\-day maintenance and problem resolution.
  

**Must have skills :** Microsoft SQL Server  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Database Administrator, your typical day involves designing, implementing, and maintaining robust database systems to support organizational needs. You will be responsible for installing database management systems and ensuring their smooth operation. Daily tasks include developing and refining procedures to manage routine maintenance and swiftly resolve any issues that arise, ensuring data integrity and availability. Collaboration with various teams to align database performance with business objectives is also a key part of your role, requiring a proactive and detail\-oriented approach to managing complex data environments.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Monitor database performance and implement changes to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Ensure data security and compliance with organizational policies and industry standards.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support in database\-related tasks.
* Document database configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps to maintain knowledge continuity.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience in database installation, configuration, and upgrading.
* Strong knowledge of backup and recovery techniques to safeguard data.
* Ability to optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, and resource management.
* Familiarity with database security practices and user access control.
* Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database\-related issues efficiently.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: Systems Integration Senior Analyst
description:
**Req ID:** 386149
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Senior Analyst to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

"•5\+ Years of experience in managing MS SQLServer databases.
  
  

* Configure and maintain database servers and processes, including monitoring of system health and performance, to ensure high levels of performance, availability, and security.
* Database performance tuning.
* Planning, deploying, maintaining, troubleshooting of high\-availability database environments (Always\-On, Clustering, Mirroring, Replication, RAC, Datagaurd, etc.).
* Independently analyze, solve, and correct issues in real time, providing problem resolution end\-to\-end.
* Refine and automate regular processes, track issues, and document changes, for efficiency and cost optimization.
* Work directly with end customer, business stakeholders as well as technical resources.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, problem solving skills
* Ability to work independently and drive the team
* Ability to multi\-task and context\-switch effectively between different activities and teams
* Strong ITIL foundation, Continual Service Improvement and Total Quality Management experiences."
